facts.statement: Remains of twelve individuals were found at the Dashanpu Quarry near Zigong in Sichuan between 1979 and 1980.
facts.quote: In 1979 and 1980, remains from twelve stegosaurian individual animals were recovered from the Dashanpu Quarry near Zigong in Sichuan.

facts.statement: The genus was named and described by Dong Zhiming, Tang Zilu, and Zhou Shiwu in 1982.
facts.quote: They were named and described by Dong Zhiming, Tang Zilu and Zhou Shiwu in 1982.

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus lived during the Bathonian to Callovian stages, approximately 165 million years ago.
facts.quote: It lived during the Bathonian to Callovian stages, around 165 million years ago

facts.statement: It lived about 20 million years before its relative Stegosaurus appeared in North America.
facts.quote: some 20 million years before its famous relative, Stegosaurus appeared in North America

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus was approximately 4 meters long, making it much smaller than Stegosaurus.
facts.quote: At only approximately 4 m long, it was also much smaller than its famous cousin.

facts.statement: The dorsal plates of Huayangosaurus were more spike-like than those of Stegosaurus.
facts.quote: In Huayangosaurus, the plates were more spike-like than in Stegosaurus.

facts.statement: It was one of the smallest known stegosaurians, reaching a length of 4 meters and a mass of 500 kg.
facts.quote: Huayangosaurus was one of the smallest known stegosaurians, at just 4 m in length and 500 kg in body mass.

facts.statement: Pairs of spikes on the rear of its tail formed a defensive weapon known as a thagomizer.
facts.quote: On the rear of the tail, pairs of spikes were present forming the so-called "thagomizer", a defensive weapon.

facts.statement: Its estimated length ranged between 4 and 4.5 meters, with a mass of around 300 kilograms.
facts.quote: Alcanzó entre 4 y 4,5 metros de longitud. Su masa se estima en alrededor de 300 kilogramos.

facts.statement: It possessed 7 premaxillary teeth and between 25 and 30 maxillary teeth.
facts.quote: Los dientes premaxilares eran 7, y los dientes maxilares eran de 25 a 30 dientes.

facts.statement: The spinal canal was dilated, a feature potentially intended to house a 'second brain'.
facts.quote: En Huajangosaurus también hubo dilatación del canal espinal, destinado a albergar el "segundo cerebro".

facts.statement: Two large spikes located above its hips may have been used to deter attacks from above.
facts.quote: Two large spikes were above its hips, and may have been used for deterring an attack from above

facts.statement: Cavities found in the plates covering its back could have contained blood vessels.
facts.quote: En las placas que cubrían la parte posterior del animal, se encontraron cavidades que podían contener vasos sanguíneos.

facts.statement: The plates may have been used for thermoregulation or to change color to scare predators or attract mates.
facts.quote: Tomarían parte en la termorregulación o cambiarían el color de las placas para asustar al depredador o atraer al compañero.

facts.statement: Researchers suggested that specimen CV 721 might represent a separate taxon due to significant differences.
facts.quote: CV 721 was found to be so different that they suggested it might be a separate taxon.

facts.statement: A theory suggests that males may have differed from females, resembling creatures with horns on their heads.
facts.quote: Existe una teoría según la cual los machos serían diferentes de las hembras que se parecían a criaturas con cuernos en la cabeza.

facts.statement: Its skull was broader and possessed premaxillary teeth, a feature lost in all later stegosaurians.
facts.quote: Its skull was broader and had premaxillary teeth in the front of its mouth. All later stegosaurians lost these teeth.

facts.statement: Twelve individuals of Huayangosaurus were recovered from the Dashanpu mine near Zigong in Sichuan.
facts.quote: Los restos de doce individuos de Huayangosaurus fueron recobrados de la mina Dashanpu, cerca de Zigong, en Sichuan

facts.statement: The species was named by Dong, Tang, and Zhou in 1982.
facts.quote: nombrados por Dong, Tang, y Zhou en 1982

facts.statement: The generic name refers to Huayang, an ancient name for Sichuan.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se refiere a Huayang, un antiguo nombre para Sichuan

facts.statement: The specific name honors the Chinese poet Li Bai, whose courtesy name was Taibai.
facts.quote: El nombre específico honra al gran poeta chino Li Bai, cuyo nombre de cortesía era Taibai

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus lived approximately 20 million years before Stegosaurus.
facts.quote: unos 20 millones de años antes que el Stegosaurus

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus shared its territory with sauropods, the ornithopod Xiaosaurus, and the carnivorous theropod Gasosaurus.
facts.quote: Huayangosaurus compartió territorio con los saurópodos Shunosaurus, Datousaurus, Omeisaurus y Protognathosaurus, el ornitópodo Xiaosaurus y el terópodo carnívoro Gasosaurus

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus is one of the most primitive known stegosaurians.
facts.quote: Huayangosaurus es uno de los más primitivos estegosaurianos conocidos

facts.statement: It was placed in its own family, Huayangosauridae, due to being sufficiently different from later forms.
facts.quote: lo suficientemente diferente como para que fuera colocado en su propia familia, Huayangosauridae

facts.statement: Its skull was wider and possessed premaxillary teeth at the front of the mouth.
facts.quote: Su cráneo era más ancho y tenía dientes premaxilares en la parte frontal de la boca

facts.statement: All later stegosaurs lost these front teeth.
facts.quote: Todos los estegosaurios posteriores perdieron estos dientes

facts.statement: Stegosauridae is defined as the clade containing all taxa more closely related to Stegosaurus than to Huayangosaurus.
facts.quote: Se definió Stegosauridae como el clado contiene todos los taxones más estrechamente relacionados con Stegosaurus que con Huayangosaurus

facts.statement: Placing it in Huayangosauridae does not prevent it from being described as a basal representative of Stegosauria.
facts.quote: Colocarlo en Huayangosauridae no le impide describirlo como un representante básico de Stegosauria

facts.statement: Two large spikes above its hips may have been used to deter attacks from above.
facts.quote: Dos picos grandes estaban por encima de sus caderas y pueden haber sido utilizados para disuadir un ataque desde arriba

facts.statement: Its plates were smaller than those of Stegosaurus with a much smaller surface area.
facts.quote: Sus placas eran más pequeñas que las de Stegosaurus , con una superficie mucho menor

facts.statement: Therefore, its plates would have been much less effective heat regulators, one of the postulated functions of plates.
facts.quote: Por lo tanto, habrían sido reguladores de calor mucho menos efectivos, una de las funciones postuladas de las placas

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus lived from the Bajocian to the Oxfordian stages, between 170.9 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Its parent group is the family Huayangosauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Huayangosauridae

facts.statement: Huayangosaurus belongs to the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: A 2008 cladogram by Mateus, Maidment, and Christiansen places Chungkingosaurus closer to Huayangosaurus than to Stegosaurus.
facts.quote: Cladograma creado por Mateus, Maidment y Christiansen en 2008 que sitúa un Chungkingosaurus más cerca de un Huayangosaurus que de Stegosaurus

rejected.statement: It is often classified within the family Huayangosauridae, defined as the largest clade containing Huayangosaurus taibaii but excluding Stegosaurus stenops.
rejected.quote: Huayangosaurus is often placed within a taxonomic family, Huayangosauridae, defined as the largest clade containing Huayangosaurus taibaii but not Stegosaurus stenops.
